params.name: pageSize
params.description: (optional) the number of products to be returned on one page. Example `100`

items.docs:
When requesting a list of products, you may include the `pageNumber` and `pageSize` as parameters.
By default, you will fetch the first page with 10 products (displayed in Response: pageNumber 0).

params.name: businessUnit
params.description: (optional) will be used as a part of the product identifier together with ‘sku’ when provided. Example `DE`

items.docs:
Get a single product by `sku` or `sku` and `businessUnit`

* In case, you’re using both `sku` and `businessUnit` as a combined identifier for your products, please provide both of them here.
* If only `sku` is provided, we will look for a product with that `sku` and an empty `businessUnit`.

info.name: Updates or create a single product

params.name: sku
params.description: (required) the part of the product identifier. Examples `123` or `LNK1230098`

items.docs:
* To create a new product include `sku` or `sku` and `businessUnit` to the JSON body.
* To update information about a product include `sku` or `sku` and `businessUnit` of that product to the JSON body. All properties will be updated, missing properties will be removed.
* Custom attributes can be added as a string type to the product.

params.name: sku

params.name: businessUnit
params.description: (optional) will be used as a part of the product identifier together with ‘sku’ when provided. Example `DE`

items.docs:
Delete a single product by `sku` or `sku` and `businessUnit`
 * A product will be deleted if `sku` or `sku` and `businessUnit` match a product in the system.
